crossRefs.note: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
to him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?
and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
and all ate the same spiritual food;
For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

translations.web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
translations.bsb: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
translations.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
translations.asv: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.
